ops.note: Entry {run name, experiment/seq, pid+pgid, spec digest, started_at, artifact paths} appended durably BEFORE launch and pid-bound at spawn; marked terminal on clean accounting (append-only terminal line rather than removal — same predicate, more durable). Startup scan treats any non-terminal entry as latch-equivalent: dead -> abort latch + refuse; live -> alarm + persistent refusal until reconciled. Deviation from this criterion's sketch: the live orphan is ALARMED and blocks startup, not auto-killed — the accounting-finale work order explicitly prescribed the watchdog alert path for live pids; killing remains the operator's reconcile step.
